summary.headline: Saffron Design Invoice Summary
key_points: Saffron Design issued an invoice to Gupta for a total amount of ₹13,715.52 on January 29th, 2019.
The invoice includes three items: frontend design restructure, custom icon package, and Gandhi mouse pad.
The payment terms are due within 15 days from the invoice date.
